No allele-specific reporter activity in MCF7.

chains.title: FOXA1-bound enhancer allele increases PRPF39

links.claim: Alt T creates a stronger forkhead/FOXA1-like motif than ref C. FOXA1 is expressed in MCF7 and is a breast-lineage TF; no QBiC-SELEX model is supplied for FOXA1 here, so this is motif-based and not direct binding evidence.
The variant lies in a plausible open-chromatin/intronic enhancer element in MCF7 where FOXA1 occupancy could change enhancer activity.
The element is assigned to PRPF39 as the nearest MCF7-expressed gene in this interval; this assignment is an assumption, not supplied evidence.
MCF7 breast cancer cells express FOXA1 and are the stated expression context.
Increased FOXA1-bound enhancer activity raises PRPF39 expression and contributes to breast cancer risk or behavior.

predictions: Alt allele shows higher FOXA1 occupancy in MCF7.
Alt reporter activity is higher in MCF7.
FOXA1 knockdown reduces PRPF39 expression in MCF7.
falsified_if: Allele-specific FOXA1 ChIP shows no alt enrichment.
Reporter assays show no allele difference.

chains.title: CTCF insulator disruption at rs11629191

links.claim: Ref C preserves a C-rich CTCF core motif better than alt T; CTCF is broadly expressed and no QBiC-SELEX model is supplied, so this is motif-based.
The variant could sit in a CTCF insulator element; loss of CTCF binding may alter chromatin domain boundaries.
Altered insulation changes PRPF39 regulatory contact frequency; target assignment is hypothetical.
MCF7 cells express CTCF and have CTCF-bound chromatin.
CTCF loss at this site de-insulates PRPF39 and contributes to breast cancer.

predictions: Ref allele shows higher CTCF occupancy.
Alt allele weakens CTCF binding and changes local chromatin contacts.
falsified_if: CTCF ChIP shows no allele-specific occupancy.
Chromatin contact assays show no insulation change.

chains.title: TFAP2C motif loss de-represses OTX2

links.claim: Ref C fits a TFAP2C/AP-2-like motif better than alt T. TFAP2C is expressed in breast cancer cells; no QBiC-SELEX model is supplied, so this is motif-based.
The element is proposed to be a TFAP2C-bound enhancer; weakened binding could change enhancer output.
The element is assumed to contact OTX2, a developmental TF gene, rather than the nearest gene.
MCF7 cells express TFAP2C and are a breast cancer context.
Loss of TFAP2C repression increases OTX2 expression and promotes breast cancer phenotypes.

predictions: Ref allele shows higher TFAP2C occupancy.
Alt allele increases OTX2 expression in MCF7.
falsified_if: TFAP2C ChIP shows no allele effect.
OTX2 expression is unchanged by allele or TFAP2C knockdown.
